Bill.BriefDescription: Providing tax exemptions for amenities purchased by lodging businesses for use by guests.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to sales and use tax exemptions for amenitiespurchased by lodging businesses for use by lodging guests; adding a newsection to chapter 82.08 RCW; and adding a new section to chapter 82.12RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.08 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The tax levied by RCW 82.08.020 does not apply to sales to alodging business of amenities. (2) A person taking the exemption under this section must keeprecords necessary for the department to verify eligibility under thissection. The exemption is available only when the buyer provides theseller with an exemption certificate in a form and manner prescribed bythe department. The seller shall retain a copy of the certificate forthe seller's files. (3) The definitions in this subsection apply to this section: (a) "Amenities" means tangible personal property exclusivelypurchased for the consumption and use of lodging guests and includes,but is not limited to: Body lotion; combs; conditioner; cotton balls; p. 1 SB 5610cotton swabs; envelopes and pencils; gift baskets and their contents;hairnets; magazines; matches; mouthwash; notepads; pens; postcards;razors; sewing kits; shampoo; shaving foam and shaving cream; shoemitts; shower caps; slippers; soap; shower gels; stationery; tissuepaper; toilet paper; toothbrushes; and toothpaste. (b) "Lodging business" means a person that furnishes lodgingtaxable by the state under this chapter.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 82.12 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) The provisions of this chapter do not apply in respect to theuse of amenities by a lodging business. (2) The definitions in section 1 of this act apply to this section.
